name: lnk_parse
description: Parse a Windows LNK (or a dump slice) and return flags, FILETIME timestamps, local/common paths, arguments, and UTF-16 strings.

size.description: Bytes to read (default 4096); structure_complete says whether the link ended inside them

scan.description: Scan the slice for multiple LNK headers

each.description: Bytes per LNK when scanning (default: up to the next LNK header, or the end of what was read)

max.description: LNKs shown inline when scanning (default 50); every one found is kept, and when there are more the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results
